svg.aria-label: Work flow of one part: Setup 2 (dual gripper + dimensional gauge)
svg.text: Work flow of one part: Setup 2 (dual gripper + dimensional gauge)
Robot 1 only tends the CNC; Robot 2 measures and sorts while the CNC is already machining the next part.

g.text: Pre-pick the next raw part with gripper A
during machining · GR-21A OK · slot empty
Wait at the CNC door holding the raw part
until: cycle complete · spindle stop · ZS-33 open
Open the door with gripper B
Exchange: B unloads, air blast, A loads
confirm: GR-21B OK · ZS-35 · PS-36 seated
Close the door with gripper A, cycle start
confirm: ZS-32 · ZS-33 locked · CNC in cycle
Place the finished part on the conveyor
Transport, stop at the end stop
confirm: ENC-43 · PE-42 · CP-3 PE-42 + CAM-2
Pick the part from the conveyor
confirm: GR-51 grip OK · CP-3 exit clear
Load the gauge nest, push to the datums
confirm: CP-5 PX-64 + CAM-2 · robot clear
Measure L, W, H (LS-61 LS-62 LS-63)

svg.text: CNC idle = steps 4 → 6 only: ≈ 20.5 s (Setup 1: 36.5 s).
Steps 7 and 2 run while the CNC machines, and
Robot 2 measures in parallel, so the quality
check never makes the CNC wait.
